```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Set Environment and load packages
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

rm(list=ls())
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, width = 2500)

if("pacman" %in% installed.packages() == FALSE) {install.packages("pacman")}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse,
               magrittr,
               foreign,
               ggcorrplot,
               ggpubr,
               ggeffects,
               Hmisc,
               car,
               psych,
               data.table,
               lme4,
               lsmeans,
               sjPlot,
               afex,
               rstatix,
               ggdark,
               effectsize)

# Set your own wd here
setwd("")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in and set up data
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

# Useful to have both wide and long dfs in order to run the different analyses and create the plots below
load("./Pilot to Study 3 clenaed and recoded (dis con).rda")
load("./Pilot to Study 3 clenaed and recoded (dis con, WIDE).rda")

# Filter out participants who met the exclusion criteria outlined in the pre-registration
cleaned_long %<>% filter(problem == 0)
cleaned %<>% filter(problem == 0)

```

## Descriptive statistics and plots
```{r descriptives}
# What is the mean, sd, median, etc. of concealment and disclosure by transmission risk condition?
describeBy(select(cleaned_long, like, tell), group = cleaned_long$risk)

# Correlation between concealment and disclosure
cor.test(cleaned_long$like, cleaned_long$tell)

# How many people were unlikely to conceal?
cleaned %>%
  filter(high_like < 4 & med_like < 4 &
         low_like < 4 & no_like < 4) %>% 
  count(n()) / nrow(cleaned)
```

```{r plots}
# Let's see what this looks like graphically
ggplot(cleaned_long, aes(x = risk, y = like)) +
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "bar", alpha = .5, fill = "#0072B2") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = .1) +
  geom_jitter(color = "#0072B2") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("None", "Low", "Medium", "High")) +
  labs(title = "Concealment likelihood by transmission risk", y = "Likelihood of concealment", x = "Transmission risk") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.title.x = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black" , size = 12, hjust = .5))
  
```

## Repeated Measures ANOVA (4 group, transmission risk)
```{r repeated ANOVA}
# Run model (like)
AOV_like <- aov_ez("ResponseId", "like", data = cleaned_long, within = "risk", type = "3")
summary(AOV_like)

cohens_f(AOV_like, alternative = "two.sided")

# compare means
cleaned_long %>%
  pairwise_t_test(like ~ risk, paired = TRUE, p.adjust.method = "bonferroni")

# Run model (tell)
AOV_tell <- aov_ez("ResponseId", "tell", data = cleaned_long, within = "risk")
nice(AOV_tell)

# compare means
cleaned_long %>%
  pairwise_t_test(tell ~ risk, paired = TRUE, p.adjust.method = "bonferroni")
```
